CatalogPage.intro: A complete listing of every entry in the archive — more an archival index than a search. Filter and order the catalogue by the entries' attributes.
CatalogPage.intro-filters: This variant folds a filter control into every column header. It is more compact, but because a filter button cannot sit inside React Aria's native sortable header, sorting falls back to a custom control — giving up React Aria's built-in sorting behaviour and its accessibility defaults.
CatalogPage.intro-standard: The default table uses React Aria's sortable columns, so each header is its own sort control with full keyboard and screen-reader support. Because React Aria owns the header, any filter controls have to live outside the table, in the toolbar above it.
CatalogPage.title: Catalog

IndexPage.lead-in: This is a starter template built with Next.js 15. It includes internationalisation, dark mode, and end-to-end testing.
IndexPage.title: Application template

SearchResults.filter-ui-dropdown-intro: A searchable dropdown of the possible facet values for each facet field, with the current filter settings listed explicitly.
SearchResults.filter-ui-list-intro: Facet side panel(s) listing every filter value next to the results. Multiple selection is possible.
SearchResults.filter-ui-tags-intro: All facet values as selectable tags in a single popover. The facet values themselves can't be searched or filtered, so it only suits facet fields with a small number of possible values.
SearchResults.intro: Free-text search across one or more fields at once. Results are ranked primarily by how closely they match your query; attribute filters can still be applied to narrow them down.
SearchResults.no-results: No documents found. Try adjusting your search query or filters.
SearchResults.title: Search Results
